title: AB 639 (2011-2012 Wisconsin Legislature, regular session): proof of identification for voting by university, college or technical college students.
operative_text:
(a_in_person_id)
(section) s. 5.02 (6m) (f)
(quote) 5.02 (6m) (f) An unexpired identification card issued by a university or college in this state that is accredited, as defined in s. 39.30 (1) (d), or by a technical college created under ch. 38 that contains the date of issuance and signature of the individual to whom it is issued and that contains an expiration date indicating that the card expires no later than 2 years after the date of issuance if the individual establishes that he or she is enrolled as a student at the university, college, or technical college on the date that the card is presented.
(b_no_id_remedy) not stated.
(c_mail_ballot_id) not stated.
(d_proof_of_citizenship) not stated.
(e_other_rule) not stated.
(other) LRB analysis (printed with the bill): This bill permits an unexpired identification card issued by a technical college that is a part of the state technical college system to be used as proof of identification if the card contains the date of issuance if the individual establishes that he or she is enrolled as a student at the technical college on the date that the card is presented, and if the identification card meets the same requirements that are app
